page_title: FRE 0-0 MAI | Freiburg v Mainz 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is replacing Paul Nebel.
90+2' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replacing Anthony Caci.
88' That's the end of the game for Ritsu Doan, who is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
87' The game is interrupted as Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is flagged offside.
86' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Anthony Caci (Mainz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

85' Paul Nebel (Mainz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mainz.
85' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
82' Dangerous play by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz). Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
76' 9:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
74' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Nadiem Amiri is replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz).
72' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Zentner (Mainz).
72' Substitution. Junior Adamu is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
72' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

72' The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
70' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
69' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
66' Substitution. Philipp Lienhart did his best and is replaced by Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg).
66' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
66' Substitution. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) has come on for Maximilian Eggestein.
63' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
63' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) inside the box. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
60' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is hurriedly cleared.

60' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
59' A terrific attempt by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
55' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
55' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Good work from Freiburg as they win a corner.
53' Flag up against Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
51' Anthony Caci (Mainz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Noah Atubolu easily deals with the threat.
49' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Half-time substitution. Jonathan Burkardt will not participate anymore and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
44' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
39' Benjamin Brand has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dominik Kohr (Mainz).
37' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
37' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Freiburg earn a corner.
34' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

34' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Robin Zentner, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Freiburg.
33' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Benjamin Brand stops the game and makes a call.
30' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
28' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
27' The ball is cleared after Anthony Caci (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Mainz will have an opportunity.
26' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner makes a comfortable save.
25' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
23' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
22' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
19' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
19' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Freiburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg). The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
17' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
16' A clumsy foul by Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
15' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
12' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
12' Mainz have a corner. Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
10' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Noah Atubolu.
9' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' Anthony Caci (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
